verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلْكَامِلِينَ طَرِيقًا، ٱلسَّالِكِينَ فِي شَرِيعَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.kjv: Blessed [are] the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِحَافِظِي شَهَادَاتِهِ. مِنْ كُلِّ قُلُوبِهِمْ يَطْلُبُونَهُ.
verses.en: Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.
verses.kjv: Blessed [are] they that keep his testimonies, [and that] seek him with the whole heart.
verses.web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا لَا يَرْتَكِبُونَ إِثْمًا. فِي طُرُقِهِ يَسْلُكُونَ.
verses.en: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.
verses.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ أَوْصَيْتَ بِوَصَايَاكَ أَنْ تُحْفَظَ تَمَامًا.
verses.en: Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.
verses.kjv: Thou hast commanded [us] to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

verses.ar: لَيْتَ طُرُقِي تُثَبَّتُ فِي حِفْظِ فَرَائِضِكَ.
verses.en: Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!
verses.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ لَا أَخْزَى إِذَا نَظَرْتُ إِلَى كُلِّ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

verses.he: אֹ֭ודְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ بِٱسْتِقَامَةِ قَلْبٍ عِنْدَ تَعَلُّمِي أَحْكَامَ عَدْلِكَ.
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

verses.ar: وَصَايَاكَ أَحْفَظُ. لَا تَتْرُكْنِي إِلَى ٱلْغَايَةِ.
verses.en: I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.
verses.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.

verses.ar: بِمَ يُزَكِّي ٱلشَّابُّ طَرِيقَهُ؟ بِحِفْظِهِ إِيَّاهُ حَسَبَ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.
verses.web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

verses.ar: بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي طَلَبْتُكَ. لَا تُضِلَّنِي عَنْ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.web: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

verses.he: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: خَبَأْتُ كَلَامَكَ فِي قَلْبِي لِكَيْلَا أُخْطِئَ إِلَيْكَ.
verses.en: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ. عَلِّمْنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: Blessed art Thou, O LORD; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Blessed [art] thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

verses.ar: بِشَفَتَيَّ حَسَبْتُ كُلَّ أَحْكَامِ فَمِكَ.
verses.en: With my lips have I told all the ordinances of Thy mouth.
verses.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

verses.ar: بِطَرِيقِ شَهَادَاتِكَ فَرِحْتُ كَمَا عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْغِنَى.
verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all riches.
verses.web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.ar: بِوَصَايَاكَ أَلْهَجُ، وَأُلَاحِظُ سُبُلَكَ.
verses.en: I will meditate in Thy precepts, and have respect unto Thy ways.
verses.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

verses.ar: بِفَرَائِضِكَ أَتَلَذَّذُ. لَا أَنْسَى كَلَامَكَ.
verses.en: I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.
verses.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

verses.ar: أَحْسِنْ إِلَى عَبْدِكَ، فَأَحْيَا وَأَحْفَظَ أَمْرَكَ.
verses.en: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.
verses.kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, [that] I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

verses.ar: ٱكْشِفْ عَنْ عَيْنَيَّ فَأَرَى عَجَائِبَ مِنْ شَرِيعَتِكَ.
verses.en: Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.
verses.kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

verses.he: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: غَرِيبٌ أَنَا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. لَا تُخْفِ عَنِّي وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.
verses.kjv: I [am] a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

verses.ar: ٱنْسَحَقَتْ نَفْسِي شَوْقًا إِلَى أَحْكَامِكَ فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ.
verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.
verses.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing [that it hath] unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

verses.ar: ٱنْتَهَرْتَ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ٱلْمَلَاعِينَ ٱلضَّالِّينَ عَنْ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

verses.he: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.ar: دَحْرِجْ عَنِّي ٱلْعَارَ وَٱلْإِهَانَةَ، لِأَنِّي حَفِظْتُ شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: جَلَسَ أَيْضًا رُؤَسَاءُ، تَقَاوَلُوا عَلَيَّ. أَمَّا عَبْدُكَ فَيُنَاجِي بِفَرَائِضِكَ.
verses.en: Even though princes sit and talk against me, thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Princes also did sit [and] speak against me: [but] thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا شَهَادَاتُكَ هِيَ لَذَّتِي، أَهْلُ مَشُورَتِي.
verses.en: Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies also [are] my delight [and] my counsellors.
verses.web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.

verses.ar: لَصِقَتْ بِٱلتُّرَابِ نَفْسِي، فَأَحْيِنِي حَسَبَ كَلِمَتِكَ.
verses.en: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

verses.ar: قَدْ صَرَّحْتُ بِطُرُقِي فَٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِي. عَلِّمْنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

verses.ar: طَرِيقَ وَصَايَاكَ فَهِّمْنِي، فَأُنَاجِيَ بِعَجَائِبِكَ.
verses.en: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.
verses.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

verses.ar: قَطَرَتْ نَفْسِي مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ. أَقِمْنِي حَسَبَ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.
verses.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.web: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

verses.ar: طَرِيقَ ٱلْكَذِبِ أَبْعِدْ عَنِّي، وَبِشَرِيعَتِكَ ٱرْحَمْنِي.
verses.en: Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.
verses.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

verses.ar: ٱخْتَرْتُ طَرِيقَ ٱلْحَقِّ. جَعَلْتُ أَحْكَامَكَ قُدَّامِي.
verses.en: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set before me.
verses.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid [before me].
verses.web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

verses.ar: لَصِقْتُ بِشَهَادَاتِكَ. يَارَبُّ، لَا تُخْزِنِي.
verses.en: I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

verses.ar: فِي طَرِيقِ وَصَايَاكَ أَجْرِي، لِأَنَّكَ تُرَحِّبُ قَلْبِي.
verses.en: I will run the way of Thy commandments, for Thou dost enlarge my heart.
verses.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.

verses.he: הֹורֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃
verses.ar: عَلِّمْنِي يَارَبُّ طَرِيقَ فَرَائِضِكَ، فَأَحْفَظَهَا إِلَى ٱلنِّهَايَةِ.
verses.en: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; and I will keep it at every step.
verses.kjv: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it [unto] the end.
verses.web: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

verses.ar: فَهِّمْنِي فَأُلَاحِظَ شَرِيعَتَكَ، وَأَحْفَظَهَا بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي.
verses.en: Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.
verses.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with [my] whole heart.
verses.web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

verses.ar: دَرِّبْنِي فِي سَبِيلِ وَصَايَاكَ، لِأَنِّي بِهِ سُرِرْتُ.
verses.en: Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

verses.ar: أَمِلْ قَلْبِي إِلَى شَهَادَاتِكَ، لَا إِلَى ٱلْمَكْسَبِ.
verses.en: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְאֹ֣ות שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.ar: حَوِّلْ عَيْنَيَّ عَنِ ٱلنَّظَرِ إِلَى ٱلْبَاطِلِ. فِي طَرِيقِكَ أَحْيِنِي.
verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.
verses.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; [and] quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

verses.ar: أَقِمْ لِعَبْدِكَ قَوْلَكَ ٱلَّذِي لِمُتَّقِيكَ.
verses.en: Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.
verses.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who [is devoted] to thy fear.
verses.web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טֹובִֽים׃
verses.ar: أَزِلْ عَارِي ٱلَّذِي حَذِرْتُ مِنْهُ، لِأَنَّ أَحْكَامَكَ طَيِّبَةٌ.
verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.
verses.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments [are] good.
verses.web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا قَدِ ٱشْتَهَيْتُ وَصَايَاكَ. بِعَدْلِكَ أَحْيِنِي.
verses.en: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.
verses.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

verses.ar: لِتَأْتِنِي رَحْمَتُكَ يَارَبُّ، خَلَاصُكَ حَسَبَ قَوْلِكَ،
verses.en: VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;
verses.kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, [even] thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

verses.ar: فَأُجَاوِبَ مُعَيِّرِي كَلِمَةً، لِأَنِّي ٱتَّكَلْتُ عَلَى كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.
verses.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

verses.he: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.ar: وَلَا تَنْزِعْ مِنْ فَمِي كَلَامَ ٱلْحَقِّ كُلَّ ٱلنَّزْعِ، لِأَنِّي ٱنْتَظَرْتُ أَحْكَامَكَ.
verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;
verses.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

verses.ar: فَأَحْفَظَ شَرِيعَتَكَ دَائِمًا، إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ،
verses.en: So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;
verses.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

verses.ar: وَأَتَمَشَّى فِي رَحْبٍ، لِأَنِّي طَلَبْتُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;
verses.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.he: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֹֽושׁ׃
verses.ar: وَأَتَكَلَّمُ بِشَهَادَاتِكَ قُدَّامَ مُلُوكٍ وَلَا أَخْزَى،
verses.en: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

verses.ar: وَأَتَلَذَّذُ بِوَصَايَاكَ ٱلَّتِي أَحْبَبْتُ.
verses.en: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

verses.he: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: وَأَرْفَعُ يَدَيَّ إِلَى وَصَايَاكَ ٱلَّتِي وَدِدْتُ، وَأُنَاجِي بِفَرَائِضِكَ.
verses.en: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.ar: اُذْكُرْ لِعَبْدِكَ ٱلْقَوْلَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتَنِي أَنْتَظِرُهُ.
verses.en: ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, because Thou hast made me to hope.
verses.kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

verses.he: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.ar: هَذِهِ هِيَ تَعْزِيَتِي فِي مَذَلَّتِي، لِأَنَّ قَوْلَكَ أَحْيَانِي.
verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.
verses.kjv: This [is] my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

verses.he: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תֹּֽורָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ ٱسْتَهْزَأُوا بِي إِلَى ٱلْغَايَةِ. عَنْ شَرِيعَتِكَ لَمْ أَمِلْ.
verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.
verses.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [yet] have I not declined from thy law.
verses.web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

verses.ar: تَذَكَّرْتُ أَحْكَامَكَ مُنْذُ ٱلدَّهْرِ يَارَبُّ، فَتَعَزَّيْتُ.
verses.en: I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself.
verses.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.web: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمِيَّةُ أَخَذَتْنِي بِسَبَبِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تَارِكِي شَرِيعَتِكَ.
verses.en: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.
verses.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَاتٍ صَارَتْ لِي فَرَائِضُكَ فِي بَيْتِ غُرْبَتِي.
verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.web: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

verses.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תֹּורָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ذَكَرْتُ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ ٱسْمَكَ يَارَبُّ، وَحَفِظْتُ شَرِيعَتَكَ.
verses.en: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.
verses.kjv: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.web: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

verses.ar: هَذَا صَارَ لِي، لِأَنِّي حَفِظْتُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.

verses.ar: نَصِيبِي ٱلرَّبُّ، قُلْتُ لِحِفْظِ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.
verses.kjv: [Thou art] my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

verses.ar: تَرَضَّيْتُ وَجْهَكَ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي. ٱرْحَمْنِي حَسَبَ قَوْلِكَ.
verses.en: I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: I intreated thy favour with [my] whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

verses.ar: تَفَكَّرْتُ فِي طُرُقِي، وَرَدَدْتُ قَدَمَيَّ إِلَى شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

verses.ar: أَسْرَعْتُ وَلَمْ أَتَوَانَ لِحِفْظِ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

verses.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תֹּֽ֝ורָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: حِبَالُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ ٱلْتَفَّتْ عَلَيَّ. أَمَّا شَرِيعَتُكَ فَلَمْ أَنْسَهَا.
verses.en: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.
verses.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: [but] I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

verses.he: חֲצֹֽות־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהֹודֹ֣ות לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: فِي مُنْتَصَفِ ٱللَّيْلِ أَقُومُ لِأَحْمَدَكَ عَلَى أَحْكَامِ بِرِّكَ.
verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

verses.he: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: رَفِيقٌ أَنَا لِكُلِّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَكَ وَلِحَافِظِي وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: I [am] a companion of all [them] that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

verses.he: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: رَحْمَتُكَ يَارَبُّ قَدْ مَلَأَتِ ٱلْأَرْضَ. عَلِّمْنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

verses.ar: خَيْرًا صَنَعْتَ مَعَ عَبْدِكَ يَارَبُّ حَسَبَ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
verses.kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.web: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.

verses.he: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֹתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
verses.ar: ذَوْقًا صَالِحًا وَمَعْرِفَةً عَلِّمْنِي، لِأَنِّي بِوَصَايَاكَ آمَنْتُ.
verses.en: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

verses.he: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.ar: قَبْلَ أَنْ أُذَلَّلَ أَنَا ضَلَلْتُ، أَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَحَفِظْتُ قَوْلَكَ.
verses.en: Before I was afflicted, I did err; but now I observe Thy word.
verses.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

verses.ar: صَالِحٌ أَنْتَ وَمُحْسِنٌ. عَلِّمْنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

verses.he: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־לֵ֤ב ׀ אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ قَدْ لَفَّقُوا عَلَيَّ كَذِبًا، أَمَّا أَنَا فَبِكُلِّ قَلْبِي أَحْفَظُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me; but I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: [but] I will keep thy precepts with [my] whole heart.
verses.web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

verses.he: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תֹּורָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
verses.ar: سَمِنَ مِثْلَ ٱلشَّحْمِ قَلْبُهُمْ، أَمَّا أَنَا فَبِشَرِيعَتِكَ أَتَلَذَّذُ.
verses.en: Their heart is gross like fat; but I delight in Thy law.
verses.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; [but] I delight in thy law.
verses.web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

verses.ar: خَيْرٌ لِي أَنِّي تَذَلَّلْتُ لِكَيْ أَتَعَلَّمَ فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, in order that I might learn Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: [It is] good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

verses.ar: شَرِيعَةُ فَمِكَ خَيْرٌ لِي مِنْ أُلُوفِ ذَهَبٍ وَفِضَّةٍ.
verses.en: The law of Thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.kjv: The law of thy mouth [is] better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

verses.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכֹונְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: يَدَاكَ صَنَعَتَانِي وَأَنْشَأَتَانِي. فَهِّمْنِي فَأَتَعَلَّمَ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

verses.he: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.ar: مُتَّقُوكَ يَرَوْنَنِي فَيَفْرَحُونَ، لِأَنِّي ٱنْتَظَرْتُ كَلَامَكَ.
verses.en: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.
verses.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

verses.he: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْتُ يَارَبُّ أَنَّ أَحْكَامَكَ عَدْلٌ، وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَذْلَلْتَنِي.
verses.en: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me.
verses.kjv: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments [are] right, and [that] thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

verses.ar: فَلْتَصِرْ رَحْمَتُكَ لِتَعْزِيَتِي، حَسَبَ قَوْلِكَ لِعَبْدِكَ.
verses.en: Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, according to Thy promise unto Thy servant.
verses.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

verses.ar: لِتَأْتِنِي مَرَاحِمُكَ فَأَحْيَا، لِأَنَّ شَرِيعَتَكَ هِيَ لَذَّتِي.
verses.en: Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.
verses.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law [is] my delight.
verses.web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: لِيَخْزَ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ لِأَنَّهُمْ زُورًا ٱفْتَرَوْا عَلَيَّ. أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُنَاجِي بِوَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: [but] I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

verses.ar: لِيَرْجِعْ إِلَيَّ مُتَّقُوكَ وَعَارِفُو شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

verses.he: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֹֽושׁ׃
verses.ar: لِيَكُنْ قَلْبِي كَامِلًا فِي فَرَائِضِكَ لِكَيْلَا أَخْزَى.
verses.en: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.
verses.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.

verses.ar: تَاقَتْ نَفْسِي إِلَى خَلَاصِكَ. كَلَامَكَ ٱنْتَظَرْتُ.
verses.en: CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.
verses.kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: [but] I hope in thy word.
verses.web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

verses.he: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: كَلَّتْ عَيْنَايَ مِنَ ٱلنَّظَرِ إِلَى قَوْلِكَ، فَأَقُولُ: «مَتَى تُعَزِّينِي؟».
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'
verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

verses.he: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיטֹ֑ור חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: لِأَنِّي قَدْ صِرْتُ كَزِقٍّ فِي ٱلدُّخَانِ، أَمَّا فَرَائِضُكَ فَلَمْ أَنْسَهَا.
verses.en: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; [yet] do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.ar: كَمْ هِيَ أَيَّامُ عَبْدِكَ؟ مَتَى تُجْرِي حُكْمًا عَلَى مُضْطَهِدِيَّ؟
verses.en: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.kjv: How many [are] the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

verses.he: כָּֽרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיחֹ֑ות אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתֹורָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ قَدْ كَرَوْا لِي حَفَائِرَ. ذَلِكَ لَيْسَ حَسَبَ شَرِيعَتِكَ.
verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.
verses.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which [are] not after thy law.
verses.web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

verses.ar: كُلُّ وَصَايَاكَ أَمَانَةٌ. زُورًا يَضْطَهِدُونَنِي. أَعِنِّي.
verses.en: All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.
verses.kjv: All thy commandments [are] faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

verses.he: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: لَوْلَا قَلِيلٌ لَأَفْنَوْنِي مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ. أَمَّا أَنَا فَلَمْ أَتْرُكْ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

verses.ar: حَسَبَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَحْيِنِي، فَأَحْفَظَ شَهَادَاتِ فَمِكَ.
verses.en: Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.
verses.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

verses.ar: إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَارَبُّ كَلِمَتُكَ مُثَبَّتَةٌ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ.
verses.en: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.
verses.kjv: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

verses.he: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כֹּונַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.ar: إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ أَمَانَتُكَ. أَسَّسْتَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَثَبَتَتْ.
verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.
verses.kjv: Thy faithfulness [is] unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

verses.he: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיֹּ֑ום כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: عَلَى أَحْكَامِكَ ثَبَتَتِ ٱلْيَوْمَ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْكُلَّ عَبِيدُكَ.
verses.en: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.
verses.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all [are] thy servants.
verses.web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

verses.he: לוּלֵ֣י תֹ֭ורָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃
verses.ar: لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ شَرِيعَتُكَ لَذَّتِي، لَهَلَكْتُ حِينَئِذٍ فِي مَذَلَّتِي.
verses.en: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.kjv: Unless thy law [had been] my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.he: לְ֭עֹולָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.ar: إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ لَا أَنْسَى وَصَايَاكَ، لِأَنَّكَ بِهَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي.
verses.en: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.
verses.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

verses.ar: لَكَ أَنَا فَخَلِّصْنِي، لِأَنِّي طَلَبْتُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: I [am] thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.he: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבֹּונָֽן׃
verses.ar: إِيَّايَ ٱنْتَظَرَ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ لِيُهْلِكُونِي. بِشَهَادَاتِكَ أَفْطُنُ.
verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: [but] I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

verses.he: לְֽכָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.ar: لِكُلِّ كَمَالٍ رَأَيْتُ حَدًّا، أَمَّا وَصِيَّتُكَ فَوَاسِعَةٌ جِدًّا.
verses.en: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: [but] thy commandment [is] exceeding broad.
verses.web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.

verses.ar: كَمْ أَحْبَبْتُ شَرِيعَتَكَ! ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ هِيَ لَهَجِي.
verses.en: MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.kjv: O how love I thy law! it [is] my meditation all the day.
verses.web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

verses.he: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֹתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَصِيَّتُكَ جَعَلَتْنِي أَحْكَمَ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي، لِأَنَّهَا إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ هِيَ لِي.
verses.en: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they [are] ever with me.
verses.web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

verses.he: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֹתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿי׃
verses.ar: أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ مُعَلِّمِيَّ تَعَقَّلْتُ، لِأَنَّ شَهَادَاتِكَ هِيَ لَهَجِي.
verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies [are] my meditation.
verses.web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

verses.ar: أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلشُّيُوخِ فَطِنْتُ، لِأَنِّي حَفِظْتُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

verses.he: מִכָּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: مِنْ كُلِّ طَرِيقِ شَرٍّ مَنَعْتُ رِجْلَيَّ، لِكَيْ أَحْفَظَ كَلَامَكَ.
verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.
verses.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

verses.ar: عَنْ أَحْكَامِكَ لَمْ أَمِلْ، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَنِي.
verses.en: I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; for Thou hast instructed me.
verses.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.web: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

verses.ar: مَا أَحْلَى قَوْلَكَ لِحَنَكِي! أَحْلَى مِنَ ٱلْعَسَلِ لِفَمِي.
verses.en: How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! [yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!
verses.web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

verses.he: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבֹּונָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי ׀ כָּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.ar: مِنْ وَصَايَاكَ أَتَفَطَّنُ، لِذَلِكَ أَبْغَضْتُ كُلَّ طَرِيقِ كَذِبٍ.
verses.en: From Thy precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
verses.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

verses.ar: سِرَاجٌ لِرِجْلِي كَلَامُكَ وَنُورٌ لِسَبِيلِي.
verses.en: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.kjv: Thy word [is] a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

verses.ar: حَلَفْتُ فَأَبِرُّهُ، أَنْ أَحْفَظَ أَحْكَامَ بِرِّكَ.
verses.en: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, to observe Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform [it], that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

verses.ar: تَذَلَّلْتُ إِلَى ٱلْغَايَةِ. يَارَبُّ، أَحْيِنِي حَسَبَ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.en: I am afflicted very much; quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
verses.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

verses.he: נִדְבֹ֣ות פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: ٱرْتَضِ بِمَنْدُوبَاتِ فَمِي يَارَبُّ، وَأَحْكَامَكَ عَلِّمْنِي.
verses.en: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

verses.he: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝תֹֽורָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: نَفْسِي دَائِمًا فِي كَفِّي، أَمَّا شَرِيعَتُكَ فَلَمْ أَنْسَهَا.
verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.
verses.kjv: My soul [is] continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

verses.he: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃
verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْرَارُ وَضَعُوا لِي فَخًّا، أَمَّا وَصَايَاكَ فَلَمْ أَضِلَّ عَنْهَا.
verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

verses.he: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֹתֶ֣יךָ לְעֹולָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשֹׂ֖ון לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.ar: وَرِثْتُ شَهَادَاتِكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ، لِأَنَّهَا هِيَ بَهْجَةُ قَلْبِي.
verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

verses.he: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשֹׂ֥ות חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעֹולָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃
verses.ar: عَطَفْتُ قَلْبِي لِأَصْنَعَ فَرَائِضَكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ إِلَى ٱلنِّهَايَةِ.
verses.en: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.
verses.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, [even unto] the end.
verses.web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُتَقَلِّبِينَ أَبْغَضْتُ، وَشَرِيعَتَكَ أَحْبَبْتُ.
verses.en: SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.
verses.kjv: I hate [vain] thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

verses.ar: سِتْرِي وَمِجَنِّي أَنْتَ. كَلَامَكَ ٱنْتَظَرْتُ.
verses.en: Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

verses.ar: ٱنْصَرِفُوا عَنِّي أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ، فَأَحْفَظَ وَصَايَا إِلَهِي.
verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

verses.ar: ٱعْضُدْنِي حَسَبَ قَوْلِكَ فَأَحْيَا، وَلَا تُخْزِنِي مِنْ رَجَائِي.
verses.en: Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.
verses.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.ar: أَسْنِدْنِي فَأَخْلُصَ، وَأُرَاعِيَ فَرَائِضَكَ دَائِمًا.
verses.en: Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.
verses.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

verses.ar: ٱحْتَقَرْتَ كُلَّ ٱلضَّالِّينَ عَنْ فَرَائِضِكَ، لِأَنَّ مَكْرَهُمْ بَاطِلٌ.
verses.en: Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.
verses.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit [is] falsehood.
verses.web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

verses.he: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: كَزَغَلٍ عَزَلْتَ كُلَّ أَشْرَارِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، لِذَلِكَ أَحْبَبْتُ شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

verses.ar: قَدِ ٱقْشَعَرَّ لَحْمِي مِنْ رُعْبِكَ، وَمِنْ أَحْكَامِكَ جَزِعْتُ.
verses.en: My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; and I am afraid of Thy judgments.
verses.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

verses.ar: أَجْرَيْتُ حُكْمًا وَعَدْلًا. لَا تُسْلِمْنِي إِلَى ظَالِمِيَّ.
verses.en: AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

verses.ar: كُنْ ضَامِنَ عَبْدِكَ لِلْخَيْرِ، لِكَيْلَا يَظْلِمَنِي ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرُونَ.
verses.en: Be surety for Thy servant for good; let not the proud oppress me.
verses.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

verses.ar: كَلَّتْ عَيْنَايَ ٱشْتِيَاقًا إِلَى خَلَاصِكَ وَإِلَى كَلِمَةِ بِرِّكَ.
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

verses.ar: ٱصْنَعْ مَعَ عَبْدِكَ حَسَبَ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَفَرَائِضَكَ عَلِّمْنِي.
verses.en: Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

verses.ar: عَبْدُكَ أَنَا. فَهِّمْنِي فَأَعْرِفَ شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: I [am] thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ وَقْتُ عَمَلٍ لِلرَّبِّ. قَدْ نَقَضُوا شَرِيعَتَكَ.
verses.en: It is time for the LORD to work; they have made void Thy law.
verses.kjv: [It is] time for [thee], LORD, to work: [for] they have made void thy law.
verses.web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَحْبَبْتُ وَصَايَاكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْإِبْرِيزِ.
verses.en: Therefore I love Thy commandments above gold, yea, above fine gold.
verses.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

verses.he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ כָּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃
verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَسِبْتُ كُلَّ وَصَايَاكَ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُسْتَقِيمَةً. كُلَّ طَرِيقِ كَذِبٍ أَبْغَضْتُ.
verses.en: Therefore I esteem all Thy precepts concerning all things to be right; every false way I hate.
verses.kjv: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts [concerning] all [things to be] right; [and] I hate every false way.
verses.web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

verses.ar: عَجِيبَةٌ هِيَ شَهَادَاتُكَ، لِذَلِكَ حَفِظَتْهَا نَفْسِي.
verses.en: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies [are] wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

verses.ar: فَتْحُ كَلَامِكَ يُنِيرُ، يُعَقِّلُ ٱلْجُهَّالَ.
verses.en: The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

verses.ar: فَغَرْتُ فَمِي وَلَهَثْتُ، لِأَنِّي إِلَى وَصَايَاكَ ٱشْتَقْتُ.
verses.en: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; for I longed for Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

verses.ar: ٱلْتَفِتْ إِلَيَّ وَٱرْحَمْنِي، كَحَقِّ مُحِبِّي ٱسْمِكَ.
verses.en: Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, as is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.
verses.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

verses.ar: ثَبِّتْ خُطُوَاتِي فِي كَلِمَتِكَ، وَلَا يَتَسَلَّطْ عَلَيَّ إِثْمٌ.
verses.en: Order my footsteps by Thy word; and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.ar: ٱفْدِنِي مِنْ ظُلْمِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ، فَأَحْفَظَ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, and I will observe Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

verses.ar: أَضِئْ بِوَجْهِكَ عَلَى عَبْدِكَ، وَعَلِّمْنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; and teach me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

verses.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תֹורָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: جَدَاوِلُ مِيَاهٍ جَرَتْ مِنْ عَيْنَيَّ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَحْفَظُوا شَرِيعَتَكَ.
verses.en: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, because they observe not Thy law.
verses.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.

verses.ar: بَارٌّ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ، وَأَحْكَامُكَ مُسْتَقِيمَةٌ.
verses.en: TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, and upright are Thy judgments.
verses.kjv: Righteous [art] thou, O LORD, and upright [are] thy judgments.
verses.web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

verses.ar: عَدْلًا أَمَرْتَ بِشَهَادَاتِكَ، وَحَقًّا إِلَى ٱلْغَايَةِ.
verses.en: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies [that] thou hast commanded [are] righteous and very faithful.
verses.web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

verses.ar: أَهْلَكَتْنِي غَيْرَتِي، لِأَنَّ أَعْدَائِي نَسُوا كَلَامَكَ.
verses.en: My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.
verses.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

verses.ar: كَلِمَتُكَ مُمَحَّصَةٌ جِدًّا، وَعَبْدُكَ أَحَبَّهَا.
verses.en: Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.
verses.kjv: Thy word [is] very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

verses.he: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: صَغِيرٌ أَنَا وَحَقِيرٌ، أَمَّا وَصَايَاكَ فَلَمْ أَنْسَهَا.
verses.en: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: I [am] small and despised: [yet] do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

verses.ar: عَدْلُكَ عَدْلٌ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ، وَشَرِيعَتُكَ حَقٌّ.
verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is the truth.
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, and thy law [is] the truth.
verses.web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

verses.ar: ضِيْقٌ وَشِدَّةٌ أَصَابَانِي، أَمَّا وَصَايَاكَ فَهِيَ لَذَّاتِي.
verses.en: Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.
verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: [yet] thy commandments [are] my delights.
verses.web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

verses.ar: عَادِلَةٌ شَهَادَاتُكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. فَهِّمْنِي فَأَحْيَا.
verses.en: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies [is] everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

verses.he: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכָל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃
verses.ar: صَرَخْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِي. ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي يَارَبُّ. فَرَائِضَكَ أَحْفَظُ.
verses.en: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: I cried with [my] whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

verses.ar: دَعَوْتُكَ. خَلِّصْنِي، فَأَحْفَظَ شَهَادَاتِكَ.
verses.en: I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

verses.ar: تَقَدَّمْتُ فِي ٱلصُّبْحِ وَصَرَخْتُ. كَلَامَكَ ٱنْتَظَرْتُ.
verses.en: I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.
verses.kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

verses.ar: تَقَدَّمَتْ عَيْنَايَ ٱلْهُزُعَ، لِكَيْ أَلْهَجَ بِأَقْوَالِكَ.
verses.en: Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the [night] watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

verses.he: קֹ֭ולִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.ar: صَوْتِيَ ٱسْتَمِعْ حَسَبَ رَحْمَتِكَ. يَارَبُّ، حَسَبَ أَحْكَامِكَ أَحْيِنِي.
verses.en: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.
verses.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلتَّابِعُونَ ٱلرَّذِيلَةَ. عَنْ شَرِيعَتِكَ بَعُدُوا.
verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.
verses.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

verses.ar: قَرِيبٌ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ، وَكُلُّ وَصَايَاكَ حَقٌّ.
verses.en: Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] near, O LORD; and all thy commandments [are] truth.
verses.web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

verses.he: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.ar: مُنْذُ زَمَانٍ عَرَفْتُ مِنْ شَهَادَاتِكَ أَنَّكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ أَسَّسْتَهَا.
verses.en: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى ذُلِّي وَأَنْقِذْنِي، لِأَنِّي لَمْ أَنْسَ شَرِيعَتَكَ.
verses.en: RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; for I do not forget Thy law.
verses.kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

verses.ar: أَحْسِنْ دَعْوَايَ.
verses.en: Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; quicken me according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

verses.he: רָחֹ֣וק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֻ֝קֶּיךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.ar: ٱلْخَلَاصُ بَعِيدٌ عَنِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَلْتَمِسُوا فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: Salvation [is] far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

verses.ar: كَثِيرَةٌ هِيَ مَرَاحِمُكَ يَارَبُّ. حَسَبَ أَحْكَامِكَ أَحْيِنِي.
verses.en: Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; quicken me as Thou art wont.
verses.kjv: Great [are] thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.web: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

verses.he: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
verses.ar: كَثِيرُونَ مُضْطَهِدِيَّ وَمُضَايِقِيَّ، أَمَّا شَهَادَاتُكَ فَلَمْ أَمِلْ عَنْهَا.
verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.
verses.kjv: Many [are] my persecutors and mine enemies; [yet] do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

verses.he: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽאֶתְקֹוטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: رَأَيْتُ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ وَمَقَتُّ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَحْفَظُوا كَلِمَتَكَ.
verses.en: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; because they observed not Thy word.
verses.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

verses.he: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.ar: ٱنْظُرْ أَنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ وَصَايَاكَ. يَارَبُّ، حَسَبَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَحْيِنِي.
verses.en: O see how I love Thy precepts; quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.
verses.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

verses.ar: رَأْسُ كَلَامِكَ حَقٌّ، وَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ كُلُّ أَحْكَامِ عَدْلِكَ.
verses.en: The beginning of Thy word is truth; and all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.
verses.kjv: Thy word [is] true [from] the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

verses.ar: رُؤَسَاءُ ٱضْطَهَدُونِي بِلَا سَبَبٍ، وَمِنْ كَلَامِكَ جَزِعَ قَلْبِي.
verses.en: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; but my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.
verses.kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

verses.he: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מֹוצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃
verses.ar: أَبْتَهِجُ أَنَا بِكَلَامِكَ كَمَنْ وَجَدَ غَنِيمَةً وَافِرَةً.
verses.en: I rejoice at Thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

verses.ar: أَبْغَضْتُ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَكَرِهْتُهُ، أَمَّا شَرِيعَتُكَ فَأَحْبَبْتُهَا.
verses.en: I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love.
verses.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: [but] thy law do I love.
verses.web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

verses.he: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יֹּום הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبَّحْتُكَ عَلَى أَحْكَامِ عَدْلِكَ.
verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

verses.he: שָׁלֹ֣ום רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תֹורָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מֹו מִכְשֹֽׁול׃
verses.ar: سَلَامَةٌ جَزِيلَةٌ لِمُحِبِّي شَرِيعَتِكَ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ مَعْثَرَةٌ.
verses.en: Great peace have they that love Thy law; and there is no stumbling for them.
verses.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

verses.ar: رَجَوْتُ خَلَاصَكَ يَارَبُّ، وَوَصَايَاكَ عَمِلْتُ.
verses.en: I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, and have done Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

verses.ar: حَفِظَتْ نَفْسِي شَهَادَاتِكَ، وَأُحِبُّهَا جِدًّا.
verses.en: My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

verses.he: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כָל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: حَفِظْتُ وَصَايَاكَ وَشَهَادَاتِكَ، لِأَنَّ كُلَّ طُرُقِي أَمَامَكَ.
verses.en: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; for all my ways are before Thee.
verses.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways [are] before thee.
verses.web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.

verses.he: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: لِيَبْلُغْ صُرَاخِي إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ. حَسَبَ كَلَامِكَ فَهِّمْنِي.
verses.en: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; give me understanding according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

verses.ar: لِتَدْخُلْ طِلْبَتِي إِلَى حَضْرَتِكَ. كَكَلِمَتِكَ نَجِّنِي.
verses.en: Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.
verses.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

verses.he: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: تُنَبِّعُ شَفَتَايَ تَسْبِيحًا إِذَا عَلَّمْتَنِي فَرَائِضَكَ.
verses.en: Let my lips utter praise: because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.
verses.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

verses.he: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שֹׁונִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כָל־מִצְוֹתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃
verses.ar: يُغَنِّي لِسَانِي بِأَقْوَالِكَ، لِأَنَّ كُلَّ وَصَايَاكَ عَدْلٌ.
verses.en: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; for all Thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments [are] righteousness.
verses.web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

verses.ar: لِتَكُنْ يَدُكَ لِمَعُونَتِي، لِأَنَّنِي ٱخْتَرْتُ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: Let Thy hand be ready to help me; for I have chosen Thy precepts.
verses.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

verses.ar: ٱشْتَقْتُ إِلَى خَلَاصِكَ يَارَبُّ، وَشَرِيعَتُكَ هِيَ لَذَّتِي.
verses.en: I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; and Thy law is my delight.
verses.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law [is] my delight.
verses.web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

verses.ar: لِتَحْيَ نَفْسِي وَتُسَبِّحَكَ، وَأَحْكَامُكَ لِتُعِنِّي.
verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; and let Thine ordinances help me.
verses.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

verses.he: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: ضَلَلْتُ، كَشَاةٍ ضَالَّةٍ. ٱطْلُبْ عَبْدَكَ، لِأَنِّي لَمْ أَنْسَ وَصَايَاكَ.
verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; for I have not forgotten Thy commandments.
verses.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
